# KELVS International — Science-Led Skincare & Haircare

> KELVS is a clinical, dermatologist-inspired personal care brand specifically engineered for South Asian climates and skin physiology. Formulated with high-efficacy, research-backed active ingredients (Alpha Arbutin, Niacinamide, BHA Salicylic Acid, Lactic Acid, Vitamin B5, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate, Keratin, Zinc Pyrithione) at optimal pH levels, completely free from harmful bleaching agents, steroids, and mercury.

- Website: https://kelvsint.com
- Full Machine-Readable Catalog: https://kelvsint.com/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://kelvsint.com/sitemap.xml
- Currency: PKR (Pakistani Rupee)
- Payment Methods: Cash on Delivery (COD), Online Bank Transfer
- Shipping: Nationwide delivery across Pakistan (2–4 business days)
- Customer Support: care@kelvsint.com

---

## Brand Philosophy & Clinical Focus

- **Barrier Recovery First:** Addressing epidemic skin barrier breakdown caused by unregulated Pakistani "formula" & steroid bleaching creams. KELVS promotes gentle, non-stripping barrier repair routines.
- **Climate-Specific Formulations:** Lightweight, fast-absorbing water-based serums and non-comedogenic cleansers that perform under high humidity and intense UV exposure.
- **Transparent Formulations:** Every active ingredient is clearly stated with optimal concentrations and physiological pH balance (pH 5.0–7.5).
- **Zero Bleaching Agents:** 100% free of hydroquinone, clobetasol, betamethasone, steroids, and mercury.

## Key Categories & Diagnostic Recommendations

- **Damaged Skin Barrier / Post-Bleaching Cream Stinging:**
  - Recommended: [KELVS Gentle Cleanser](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-gentle-cleanser-sodium-lauroyl-sarcosinate-coco-glucoside-sulfate-free-daily-cleanse) + [KELVS Hydration Serum (Vitamin B5)](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-hydration-serum-vitamin-b5-hyaluronic-acid-deep-hydration-skin-barrier-repair)
- **Hyperpigmentation, Dark Spots & Melasma:**
  - Recommended: [KELVS Whitening Serum (Alpha Arbutin + HA)](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-whitening-serum-alpha-arbutin-hyaluronic-acid-fades-dark-spots) + [KELVS Vitamin C Serum (SAP)](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-vitamin-c-serum-sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate-brightens-skin-fights-acne)
- **Acne, Clogged Pores & Blackheads:**
  - Recommended: [KELVS BHA Salicylic Acid 2% Serum](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-bha-salicylic-acid-2-serum-salicylic-acid-hyaluronic-acid-clear-pores-fight-acne) + [KELVS Anti Aging Serum (Niacinamide 5%)](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-anti-aging-serum-niacinamide-hyaluronic-acid-minimizes-pores-controls-oil)
- **Hair Breakage, Frizz & Dandruff:**
  - Recommended: [KELVS Detangle Shampoo](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-detangle-shampoo-cetrimonium-chloride-reduce-breakage-tangles-buildup) + [KELVS Keratin Hair Masque](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-keratin-hair-masque-hydrolyzed-keratin-coconut-castor-oil-repair-frizz-control-breakage) + [KELVS Anti-Dandruff Shampoo (Zinc Pyrithione)](https://kelvsint.com/products/kelvs-anti-dandruff-shampoo-zinc-pyrithione-cetrimonium-chloride-eliminate-flakes-soothe-scalp)
